teaser: The second edition of Generation Z Developers must be short and punchy, co-written with Claude and credited, and show with evidence it is not AI slop.
core_idea: The book is for anyone getting into AI, so it includes practical chapters like setting up the agentic email workflow; it keeps the first edition's short, punchy style; it credits Claude as co-writer and shows the ratio of memo to word; it meets the slop suspicion with evidence; every paragraph carries its evidence, facts, hypotheses and purpose in a graph that also catches repetition; synthetic readers test it; and not every finding is fixed.
